item.title: Light-Bot: Resilient Grid Power Monitoring & Telegram Notification Engine
item.description: In our newly built apartment building, both my neighbors and I found it extremely helpful to know exactly when grid power was on and when it went out. Because my home router and home server are backed up by battery and never shut down during blackouts, I built a straightforward and reliable solution: an in-apartment probe that continuously pings devices plugged directly into raw 220V mains, automatically computing outage durations and notifying all neighbors via a dedicated Telegram channel.
